card.name: Verbs right before the word that
card.fires_on: Verbs or conjunctions such as provided, ensure, anticipate and suggests when the next word is "that" and it opens a clause. Seen in explanatory and scientific prose.

modes.label: Verb of finding or aim
modes.description: A verb like suggests, ensure or anticipate that introduces a clause stating a result or goal.
modes.example: The finding of increased risk with AEDs of varying mechanisms of action and across a range of indications<< suggests>> that the risk applies to all AED

modes.label: Provided that
modes.description: The word provided used as a condition, followed by that.
modes.example: An object that is thrown vertically upward is also a projectile (<<provided>> that the influence of air resistance is negligible

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning "that is" in several languages, so it favors a plain English "that" clause rather than an explanatory restatement.
